trigger: U08's archive-safety number (25 of 40 runs green before and after) reproduced three times and was correct, but the MECHANISM cited was false: only some invariant arms are version-gated, the rest fire on adoption at any version, and the release's own 1.10.0 fixture emitted a FAIL. The parity held because 0 of 506 archived documents had adopted the new fields - an unmeasured empirical accident. One verifier initially re-derived the same wrong mechanism and shipped a PASS on it.
lesson: A correct number with a wrong mechanism is a defect, because the mechanism is what a human reads at sign-off and what the next run reasons from.
how_to_apply: A correct number with a wrong mechanism is a defect, because the mechanism is what a human reads at sign-off and what the next run reasons from. Whenever a safety claim rests on an absence, state the mechanism by which the thing WOULD have appeared, verify that mechanism is the real one (MU-L47), and publish the census that actually carries the guarantee together with its command. Treat a verifier reproducing the executor's reasoning as evidence the claim is MISLEADING, not as corroboration.
